subject: Sorry for the gate code confusion
text:
I'm sorry about the mix-up with the tool shed key. After the club meeting, I left a note on the fence saying that the spare key was under the blue pot, but that instruction was too vague, especially with several pots sitting near the path. You probably searched the wrong place, waited in the sun, and then had to rearrange your afternoon because the trimmer stayed locked away. That was my mistake, not yours.

To fix it quickly, I have taped a duplicate key inside the little mailbox attached to my porch railing. The box is unlocked, and the key is in a small envelope labeled Shed club. If you need the trimmer before the next meeting, take it and leave the key in the pocket door of the trimmer cabinet, so the next person can find it without asking anyone.

I will stop leaving cryptic notes and will send clearer instructions with photos or specific landmarks. If the key is not in the mailbox by tomorrow morning, reply to this message or knock on my back door. I would rather sort it out directly than have another neighbor frustrated by my sloppy planning. If you lost time trying to find it, I can bring a bag of soil to help repay that inconvenience. Please tell me what is easiest, and I will make it right without making you chase me for details. No need to reply if the key is already in your hand.

Again, sorry for the wasted time.

Thanks, Club member
